item.title: Dhupi, Salla ra Laligurans ko Fedma by Parijat: A Book Talk
item.description: Parijat’s Dhupi, Salla ra Laligurans ko Fedma is autoethnography that consists of her life description from her childhood till the point she leaves Darjeeling to Kathmandu.
